notes:
Background: Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer onboarding + in-app help). Currently running prod on another provider (OpenAI + custom proxy). Evaluating Redwood Hosted first to verify prompt parity, then move to Dedicated for cost predictability and throughput.

Key ask: migration path with minimal product regression. They want a compatibility layer so current SDK calls and prompt templates require minimal change. Explicit asks: exact stop/token behaviour parity, identical embeddings spaces (cosine similarity), and deterministic reranker outputs for A/B tests.

Performance targets & constraints:
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for short-chat flows (64 token), p95 < 700ms for longer generation (<=512 tokens).
- Throughput: 60-120 requests/sec (burstable).
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — want 20-40% unit-cost reduction when moving to Dedicated.
- Data/security: Must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration, audit logs retention 1 year, option to keep residency in NA.

POC plan (agreed in call):
- Phase 1 (Hosted API): 2-week parity run using 6 canonical prompts + 50 evaluation queries. Measure semantic similarity metrics + human eval for regressions.
- Phase 2 (Dedicated POC): 4-week run on reserved nodes, compare latency/throughput/cost and test autoscale behaviors.
- Phase 3: Migration runbook & canary rollout (if POCs pass).

- 2026-02-11 discovery call (ff_2026-02-11_00123): "If we see >5% QA regression on core flows we can't go live."
- 2026-02-18 technical deep-dive with SE (Priya) — discussed KV cache, continuous batching, and kernel differences. Priya to provide recommended quantization/profile for our workload.
- 2026-03-02 pricing review (ff_2026-03-02_00456): Asked for 12-month committed discount scenarios and burst allowance on Dedicated.

Security/legal: They ran Redwood security FAQ vs current provider; raised standard SOC2 + SAML requirements. Legal asked for data residency addendum; security team asked for drive link to SOC2 report (provided).

Open items / blockers:
- Need a short script that demonstrates SDK compatibility (translate existing client calls to Redwood hosted endpoints). Engineering is waiting on that sample + migration notes.
- Evals: L1 human evals to flag generated text regressions; need Redwood to provide model variant mapping (which Redwood model corresponds to our current provider model).
- Pricing: Need dedicated sizing guidance and committed ARR scenarios in writing.

Next demo / milestones:
- 2026-03-18: Hosted parity demo scheduled (internal eval team + Redwood SE).
- 2026-04-02: If parity metrics pass, kick off Dedicated POC (3–4 weeks).

Stance: Product/Eng very pragmatic — will migrate if parity + cost wins + reasonable engineering effort (<2 sprints). GTM/Finance need clearer committed pricing and cancellation terms.
